description: Re:port Flow is a cloud service for creating document templates and generating PDFs such as invoices, reports, and application forms. It provides a visual template editor, API-based PDF generation, and AI-client integration via MCP.
summary: Re:port Flow exposes a REST API at `api.re-port-flow.com/v1` for PDF/document generation plus an MCP server at `mcp.re-port-flow.com/mcp`; the API supports `appkey` header auth or OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens, and the MCP server uses OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration. It also ships an npm-distributed local MCP executable (`reportflow-mcp`) run via `npx`.
